summary: More job settings: per-event stdout display limit, websocket messages per second, maximum scheduled jobs per template, callback plugin paths, default job timeout and idle timeout (0 means none), default inventory and project update timeouts (overridden per source or project), and the per-host fact cache timeout.
questions: How do I set a default job timeout in automation controller?
How long are cached facts valid in controller?
How do I limit queued scheduled jobs?
What is the default job idle timeout?
